sources.title: FastWan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers · Models
sources.snippet: FastWan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers is built upon Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers. It supports efficient 3-step inference and produces high-quality videos at 61×448×832 resolution. For training, we use the FastVideo 480P Synthetic Wan dataset, which contains 600k synthetic latents.

sources.title: FastWan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers Open-source Video Generation Model - High ...
sources.snippet: FastWan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers is a video generation model fine-tuned based on the new Sparse-distill strategy. It combines the advantages of distillation and sparse attention, supports efficient 3-step reasoning, and can generate high-quality videos at a resolution of 61×448×832.
